offers_products.reason: Online insurance marketplace; sells lead generation and matching, not manufactured goods or software licences.

offers_services.reason: Operates an insurance comparison marketplace, matching shoppers with carriers and agents; customer acquisition service for insurers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Quotes are free to consumers; paying customers are carriers and agents, who buy the leads and clicks.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Insurance carriers and local agents pay for high-intent consumer leads and customer acquisition.

recurring_revenue.reason: Carriers and agents repeatedly buy leads and clicks; ongoing performance marketing spend, though mostly not contractual.

cyclical_demand.reason: Carriers' advertising and customer acquisition budgets can be cut or paused when markets or profitability worsen.

big_ticket.reason: Leads and referrals are small, frequent purchases billed per lead or click.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its data, matching technology and online platform, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main paying customers are large national insurance carriers, though thousands of local agents also buy.

asset_heavy.reason: Online platform and marketing business needing little physical investment.

notes: Revenue mix between carriers and agents is not stated on the site, so the large-customer answer rests on carriers being the main buyers.
